# Cumulo UI — Expanded Machine Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Detailed reference including component APIs, TypeScript signatures, and composition patterns for AI coding assistants.

---

## 1. Core rules for coding assistants

### Layout: use Cumulo primitives instead of `<div>`
```tsx
// ❌ WRONG: Raw <div> flex container
<div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
  <Button>Cancel</Button>
  <Button variant="primary">Submit</Button>
</div>

// ✅ CORRECT: Cumulo layout primitives
<HStack gap="sm" align="center">
  <Button>Cancel</Button>
  <Button variant="primary">Submit</Button>
</HStack>
```

### Forms: use compound `Field` components
```tsx
// ❌ WRONG: Monolithic guessed input
<Input label="Email address" error={errors.email} value={email} />

// ✅ CORRECT: Compound Field namespace
<Field.Root isInvalid={Boolean(errors.email)}>
  <Field.Label>Email address</Field.Label>
  <Field.Input
    type="email"
    value={email}
    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
    placeholder="you@example.com"
  />
  <Field.Description>We will send account notifications here.</Field.Description>
  {errors.email && <Field.Error>{errors.email}</Field.Error>}
</Field.Root>
```

### Styling: use `@cumulo/css` with design tokens
```tsx
// ❌ WRONG: Tailwind or inline style with raw hex
<div className="flex p-4 bg-[#1e293b] rounded-lg">...</div>
<div style={{ padding: '16px', background: '#ffffff' }}>...</div>

// ✅ CORRECT: @cumulo/css with vars.* tokens
import { style } from '@cumulo/css';
import { vars } from '@cumulo/core';

const cardStyle = style({
  padding: vars.spacing.md,
  backgroundColor: vars.color.background.base,
  borderRadius: vars.radius.md,
  border: `1px solid ${vars.color.grey.base}`,
});
```

---

## 2. Component API reference

### Layout primitives

#### `<HStack>` / `<VStack>` / `<Stack>`
```ts
export interface StackProps extends ElementProps<HTMLDivElement> {
  direction?: 'row' | 'column';
  gap?: 'none' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl';
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch' | 'baseline';
  justify?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between' | 'around';
  wrap?: boolean;
}
```

#### `<Container>`
```ts
export interface ContainerProps extends ElementProps<HTMLDivElement> {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full'; // max-width bounding
  padding?: 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}
```

#### `<Flow>`
```ts
export interface FlowProps extends ElementProps<HTMLDivElement> {
  gap?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
}
```

---

### App layout primitives

#### `<AppFrame>`
Top-level application container coordinating header, sidebar, navigation, and main view regions.

#### `<Sidebar>`
Collapsible multi-level sidebar navigation.
```tsx
import { Sidebar, useSidebar } from '@cumulo/core';

<Sidebar defaultExpanded>
  <Sidebar.Header>
    <Sidebar.Toggle />
  </Sidebar.Header>
  <Sidebar.Body>
    <SideNav>
      <SideNav.Item href="/dashboard" active>Dashboard</SideNav.Item>
      <SideNav.Item href="/settings">Settings</SideNav.Item>
    </SideNav>
  </Sidebar.Body>
  <Sidebar.Footer>
    <ThemeToggle />
  </Sidebar.Footer>
</Sidebar>
```

---

### Form primitives

#### Compound `<Field>`
```tsx
import { Field } from '@cumulo/core';

// Root coordinates isInvalid, IDs, and dynamic part registration
<Field.Root isInvalid={false}>
  <Field.Label>Username</Field.Label>
  <Field.Input placeholder="Enter username" />
  <Field.Description>Must be 3-20 characters long.</Field.Description>
  <Field.Error>Username is already taken.</Field.Error>
</Field.Root>
```

#### `<Checkbox>`, `<Radio>`, `<Switch>`
```tsx
import { Checkbox, Radio, RadioList, Switch } from '@cumulo/core';

<Checkbox checked={accepted} onChange={setAccepted} label="Agree to terms" />

<Switch checked={notifications} onChange={setNotifications} label="Enable notifications" />

<RadioList value={selectedPlan} onChange={setSelectedPlan}>
  <Radio value="free" label="Free Tier" />
  <Radio value="pro" label="Pro Tier" />
</RadioList>
```

---

### Overlays (native top-layer)

#### `<Dialog>` (HTML5 `<dialog>`)
```tsx
import { Dialog, Button } from '@cumulo/core';

<Dialog.Root>
  <Dialog.Trigger>
    <Button variant="primary">Open Dialog</Button>
  </Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Portal>
    <Dialog.Content>
      <Dialog.Header>
        <Dialog.Title>Confirm Action</Dialog.Title>
      </Dialog.Header>
      <Dialog.Body>
        Are you sure you want to proceed?
      </Dialog.Body>
      <Dialog.Footer>
        <Dialog.Close>
          <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
        </Dialog.Close>
        <Button variant="primary">Confirm</Button>
      </Dialog.Footer>
    </Dialog.Content>
  </Dialog.Portal>
</Dialog.Root>
```

#### `<Popover>` & `<Tooltip>`
```tsx
import { Popover, Tooltip, Button } from '@cumulo/core';

<Popover.Root>
  <Popover.Trigger>
    <Button>Toggle Menu</Button>
  </Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>
    Menu options here
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover.Root>

<Tooltip content="Edit profile">
  <Button variant="ghost">Edit</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

---

### Feedback and display

#### `<Button>`
```ts
export interface ButtonProps extends ElementProps<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
  intent?: 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

#### `<Badge>`
```ts
export interface BadgeProps extends ElementProps<HTMLSpanElement> {
  variant?: 'solid' | 'subtle' | 'outline';
  intent?: 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}
```

#### `<Card>`
```tsx
import { Card, Heading, Text, Button } from '@cumulo/core';

<Card>
  <Card.Header>
    <Heading size="lg">Project Overview</Heading>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>
    <Text>Active tasks and system health metrics.</Text>
  </Card.Body>
  <Card.Footer>
    <Button variant="secondary">View Details</Button>
  </Card.Footer>
</Card>
```

---

## 3. Styling engine reference (`@cumulo/css`)

### Static styles (`style`)
```ts
import { style } from '@cumulo/css';
import { vars } from '@cumulo/core';

export const containerStyle = style({
  display: 'flex',
  flexDirection: 'column',
  gap: vars.spacing.md,
  backgroundColor: vars.color.background.base,
  padding: vars.spacing.lg,
  borderRadius: vars.radius.lg,
});
```

### Variant recipes (`recipe`)
```ts
import { recipe } from '@cumulo/css';
import { vars } from '@cumulo/core';

export const alertRecipe = recipe({
  base: {
    padding: vars.spacing.md,
    borderRadius: vars.radius.md,
    fontFamily: vars.font.sans,
  },
  variants: {
    intent: {
      info: { backgroundColor: vars.color.primary.subtle, color: vars.color.primary.base },
      error: { backgroundColor: vars.color.error.subtle, color: vars.color.error.base },
      success: { backgroundColor: vars.color.success.subtle, color: vars.color.success.base },
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    intent: 'info',
  },
});
```

### Class merging (`cx`)
```ts
import { cx } from '@cumulo/css';

const className = cx(alertRecipe({ intent: 'error' }), customClassName);
```
